row: ARF Hamptons - Animal Rescue Fund of the Hamptons

Established in 1974, the Animal Rescue Fund of the Hamptons, also known as ARF Hamptons, is a nonprofit organization that has rescued more than 33,500 cats and dogs. Entirely funded by donations, ARF provides food, shelter, love, medical care, and behavioral training for its rescue animals for as long as it takes to find loving homes. To learn more about ARF Hamptons and ways you can support ARF's rescue efforts, visit arfhamptons.org and follow @arfhamptons
